findings.what: I3 merge key uses frozensets of (type, key): stoichiometry and repeated participants are ignored, and the state is reduced to the compartment key (location, cell type), so tissue and species are ignored. Exact on this corpus, latent for 2A->B vs A->B.
findings.fix: key on sorted (type, key, stoichiometry) tuples, and add tissue and species to the state part

findings.what: selfcheck is independent of the renderer model (it reads the IR and SVG data-* attributes) but does not check stoichiometry, direction or that merged steps are truly identical; it trusts data-* attributes rather than geometry (a path with no d would pass). Only a drop-reaction negative proof is committed. Dead variable txt at line 106.
findings.fix: assert all members of a data-k group share left/right multisets with stoichiometry, state and direction; add an interaction-drop negative proof
